 Celebrate Thanksgiving at Dallas’ Best All-Around Restaurant with a Chef-Prepared Holiday Feast at McRae’s 
 By Sam Redig on October 26, 2026 6:23 PM Comments Off on Celebrate Thanksgiving at Dallas’ Best All-Around Restaurant with a Chef-Prepared Holiday Feast at McRae’s

 DALLAS, TX (October 26, 2026) — This Thanksgiving, McRae’s American Bistro & Cocktails invites families, couples, and friends to leave the cooking and cleanup behind and enjoy a memorable holiday meal at one of Dallas’ most celebrated dining destinations.
 Located at 9913 Garland Road near White Rock Lake, the award-winning East Dallas restaurant will welcome guests on Thursday, November 26, for a special Thanksgiving dining experience featuring a chef-prepared prix fixe holiday feast, signature à la carte favorites, and an intimate setting perfect for a holiday celebration with family and friends.
 A Thanksgiving Feast from McRae’s Award-Winning Kitchen 
 Executive Chef Alejandro Quintano and his culinary team have created a special two-course prix fixe Thanksgiving dinner , offered at $39 per adult and $15 for children under 12.
 The experience begins with a choice of McRae’s Famous Tomato Soup or Granny Smith Salad, followed by a traditional holiday feast featuring roasted turkey breast, cornbread dressing, roasted garlic mashed potatoes with turkey gravy, green beans amandine, and house-made cranberry sauce.
 And for those who have never been particularly excited about turkey? McRae’s has them covered, too. Guests can choose from à la carte favorites such as Filet Mignon, Salmon Meunière, or Lemon Caper Chicken, with additional appetizers, sides, and indulgent desserts like Bourbon Pecan Pie and Vanilla Crème Brûlée available to complete the celebration.
 A Distinctive Setting for a Memorable Holiday 
 With its eclectic mix of vintage furnishings, rich colors, ornate chandeliers, unexpected décor, and cozy dining nooks, McRae’s offers an atmosphere as distinctive as its cuisine. Every corner has its own personality, creating a setting that feels both sophisticated and comfortably inviting, perfect for gathering with loved ones around the Thanksgiving table.
 Recently named Best All-Around Restaurant in the Dallas Observer’s Best of Dallas 2026, McRae’s has also earned back-to-back Best Chef honors from Dining Out in Dallas, four Gold awards in the Dallas Morning News Best in DFW, and multiple Advocate awards recognizing its exceptional hospitality and celebratory dining experiences.
 Thanksgiving Day 2026 
 Date: Thursday, November 26
 Hours: 11:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.
 Prix Fixe Thanksgiving Dinner: $39 Adults | $15 Children Under 12
 Menu: mcraesamericanbistro.com/thanksgiving-at-mcraes 
 Reservations can be made online through Resy , by calling 214-792-9944 , or by emailing mcraes@ffamgt.com .
 Because of McRae’s intimate setting and limited seating capacity, advance reservations are strongly encouraged. Guests are invited to secure their tables early to ensure availability for their preferred dining time.
